habitat: Moist and dry broadleaf forest, forest edge, secondary growth, bamboo, riverine woodland and well-vegetated gardens near forest; lower and mid canopy, shaded perches; 0–1800 m
description: Small azure-blue monarch flycatcher (male with black nape patch and narrow black breast band, whitish belly; female duller, blue-grey head, brownish upperparts, lacking the black markings); sits upright on shaded low to mid-canopy perches and sallies for flying insects, often joining mixed-species foraging flocks; moist and dry forest, forest edge and bamboo of the Jammu foothills.
